methods.method_purpose: Constructs and initializes the AddDevice page object by invoking the parent HPXRebrandingFlow class constructor with the provided WebDriver instance, setting up the necessary foundation for device addition workflows.

methods.method_description: Select Add Device from Home screen.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Specifies which tile to use for adding device

methods.method_purpose: Initiates the device addition workflow by navigating from the Home screen to the Add Device interface through interaction with the specified tile element, defaulting to TILE_1 if no tile parameter is provided.
Performs validation checks to ensure the Add Device screen has loaded correctly and displays all expected UI elements, confirming successful navigation to the device addition interface.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: The printer setup option to select

methods.method_purpose: Facilitates the printer configuration process by selecting a designated setup option from the available printer setup choices presented on the Add Device screen, enabling users to proceed with their preferred setup method.
Validates that the Printer Setup screen has rendered properly with all required UI components visible and accessible, ensuring the user can proceed with printer configuration.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to select from the list

methods.method_purpose: Identifies and selects a target printer from the displayed list of available printers by matching the provided printer name, enabling the user to proceed with connecting the specific device.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to verify connection status

methods.method_purpose: Confirms successful printer connection by verifying that the specified printer appears on the Home screen with an active connection status, validating the completion of the device addition workflow.

methods.method_description: Verify Add Device button is visible.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Specifies which tile to check for Add Device button

methods.method_purpose: Validates the presence and visibility of the Add Device button on the designated tile of the Home screen, ensuring users have access to the device addition functionality from the specified location.
